_comment: The whole Short, drawn. The first line is carried in `variants` because tts.mjs treats that as the hook; here the hook IS the first thing drawn.
_numbers: $800 and $150 are deliberately round and deliberately NOT the fixture figures ($845.00 / $186.35). The drawing illustrates the shape of the problem rather than quoting a document, and nobody holds two decimal places in their head off a feed. If this ever cuts to the real documents, the numbers have to agree again.

body.text: This is you at two in the morning.
You go to the hospital. They fix you. You go home. Nice.
Three weeks later, two envelopes turn up.
The hospital wants $800. Your insurance says $150.
The one from the hospital is the bill.
The one from your insurance is not a bill. It says so, right at the top.
That one tells you what you actually owe.
So if the bill asks for more, that is a phone call before it is a payment.
Check yours before you dispute. Or upload them free at useclaimright.com.
